question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**aligning**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes how tea prices have behaved in relation to the prices of other companies during the past three months.
 
• The word "aligning" is appropriate here as it means that tea prices have been corresponding or matching with the prices of other companies.
